ambient: A dose of time is administered. Some passes.
Everything gets one increment further away and stays there.
You almost move. The intention is filed for later.
description: You have come to rest on a flat place. It is comfortable in the way that being put down is comfortable. There is a great deal of space above you and it is all the same distance away. Time is being administered here in doses and you are between them.
name: The Shelf

looks: All of it exactly as far away as the rest of it.
It has a texture, if you stop insisting on looking.
Something is up there being still, and being still is what it does.
objects.name: the space above

looks: It holds you the way a hand holds a small animal that has stopped struggling.
It has the shape of you already worn into it, from before.
objects.name: the flat place

weather: Not cold. Not warm. The temperature of being carried.
